title: OHC Playbook
description: Ways of using one or more lenses, and the person's accepted results in them, in named situations. Guidance for the helper: it grants nothing and states nothing about any person (PB-4). Registry document (spec/playbooks/<name>.playbook.json); a local playbook (x- id) lives in a context's lenses/ folder and is pinned in Context.playbooks (LENSES.md §2.2, PB-1).

id.description: urn:ohc:playbook:<name> in the registry; urn:ohc:playbook:x-<namespace>:<name> for a local playbook from practice.

author.description: One string, as an entry of a lens descriptor's descriptorAuthors: "OHC editors"; or the name of a public source, which sources then cites; or, for a local playbook, the person's or practitioner's own label.

sources.description: Public citations only. At least one when author is a public source (PB-1). Never internal file paths.

Words.description: Plain words in English (required) and Russian (required in the registry, PB-1).

Steps.description: 2 to 5 short steps per language; the same count in each language given (PB-1).

id.description: A slug unique in the playbook. No closed list; LENSES.md §2.2 lists the shared slugs as informative.

use.description: How to use the lens and the person's accepted results here.

toolkit.description: Toolkit item ids of the playbook's lenses, each with agentMayOffer true (PB-1). May be empty.

results.description: Construct ids of the playbook's lenses that the steps draw on (PB-1).

watchFor.description: What not to do in this situation.
